I am the Escape Hermit!"{wait}"The Escape art takes you out of a cave and back to the surface in an instant!"{wait}"Hurry and learn my art, and teach those oni a lesson!"{wait}"But first, you must undergo my rather strict training!"{wait}"Now, listen carefully to what I say!"{wait}"Up!"{c28}{n}"Down!"{c28}{n}"Left!"{c28}{n}"Right!"{c28}{n}"Up!"{c28}{n}"Down!"{c28}{n}"Left!"{c28}{n}"Right!"{c28}{n}"...Now press the directional buttons in the same order I just said them!"
